description: This Java source file defines the SeoControlServlet class, which extends ControlServlet and serves as a central servlet for handling SEO-related requests within a web application. It manages initialization parameters and dispatches GET requests to appropriate servlets based on request attributes and URI patterns.

classes.name: SeoControlServlet
classes.description: A servlet for managing SEO-related requests, extending the ControlServlet class, with initialization and request handling logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, sets default page and control servlet parameters, and initializes SEO configurations.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests, serving JSP or default servlets based on request attributes and request URI pattern.
